intent: Record how eval and run collaborate now that a batch starts trials through an idempotent origin key instead of borrowing run's transaction, so the next change to either side meets a reviewed boundary.
observable_outcome: analyze-boundary between eval and run reports the trial port (with its idempotency), the run-fact reader and the verdict reader; the wait-or-stop policy is a reviewed eval Rule; wiring-interactions no longer needs eval->run or run->eval held in its baseline.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Asking run twice with the same origin key yields one Run; the same key with another Skill Version is refused.
Which refusals pass is run's published fact; whether a batch waits or stops on it is eval's Rule.
The eval->run and run->eval wiring edges match reviewed interactions, so they leave the wiring_edges baseline.
The approval that makes the records reviewed is checkable outside the package.
